assessment.gateHonesty: 26/71 remains fail-closed; no false completion. F1 prevents two implemented features qualifying. Three mutation spot-checks constrain behavior.
assessment.architecture: Core/schema remain pure; loader injects capabilities and verifies before publication; renderer validates manually registered artwork.
